subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

She has given / me a book / last week / which I returned.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **She has given**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace **'has given' **with **'gave'** to make the sentence correct.
 
• **Has + past participle** is the **present perfect **used in 3rd person singular form.
 
• The **present perfect** tense is an English verb tense used for **past actions that are related to or continue into the present**.
 
• In the given sentence, The past form '**gave**' should be used because the narrator **already returned** the book, therefore **no continuous process is there**.
 
• We use the **second form (or v2 form) **when we are talking about something that **happened in the past**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Corrected sentence:** *She gave me a book last week which I returned.*
